text: Takes ages until you can start and see how much it costs because of the 1000 questions about yourself at the beginning. Then you see that actually there is no free or light version at all.
author: Bernadette Szeder

text: This is a good app, but I have a few suggestions: - it would be nice to be able to edit the habits afterwards - you could have a chart of the habits - the names of the basic habits can't be rewritten,this would be nice to change - breathing exercises, movement, meditation, relax music, these could be added - more articles would be good - to start the week on Monday instead of Sunday. Otherwise useful,good app,but could be improved.
author: Nina Nagy
